ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Desktopimgdownldr Target File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious Microsoft desktopimgdownldr file creation that stores a file to a suspicious location or contains a file with a suspicious extension

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Personalization\\\\LockScreenImage\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*")) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.png.*")))
